title: AtomSteer: Test-Time Constraint Steering for Atomistic Generative Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.38517v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Diffusion and flow matching models offer scalable approaches to generating crystalline materials, molecular conformers, and protein-ligand complexes. However, satisfying crystallographic symmetry, structural geometry, and accurate stereochemistry remains challenging. Satisfying these requirements calls for corrections that preserve the geometry already captured by the pretrained model. In this work, we propose AtomSteer, a test-time inference framework for steering pretrained atomistic generative models with structural constraints. During sampling, AtomSteer corrects intermediate structure predictions with bounded local projections, graph-rigid stereochemical transformations, and projections over periodic symmetries, accepting updates that improve constraint satisfaction while limiting changes to the rest of the structure. We demonstrate AtomSteer across three pretrained backbones, FlowMM, ET-Flow, and Boltz-2, spanning de novo crystal

translated_title: AtomSteer：面向原子生成模型的测试时约束引导
translated_abstract: 扩散模型和流匹配模型为生成晶体材料、分子构象以及蛋白质-配体复合物提供了可扩展的方法。然而，满足晶体对称性、结构几何约束和精确立体化学要求仍然具有挑战性。满足这些要求需要进行修正，同时保留预训练模型已经捕获的几何结构。在这项工作中，我们提出了AtomSteer，一个用于引导预训练原子生成模型的测试时推理框架。在采样过程中，AtomSteer通过有界局部投影、图刚性立体化学变换以及周期对称性投影来修正中间结构预测，接受能够改善约束满足度的更新，同时限制对结构其余部分的更改。我们在三个预训练骨干模型（FlowMM、ET-Flow和Boltz-2）上演示了AtomSteer，涵盖了从头晶体……
tldr: 提出了AtomSteer测试时推理框架，通过有界局部投影、图刚性立体化学变换和周期对称性投影，在不破坏预训练原子生成模型已学到的几何结构的前提下，引导其满足晶体对称性、结构几何和立体化学等约束。
en_tdlr: AtomSteer is a test-time inference framework that steers pretrained atomistic generative models to satisfy crystallographic symmetry, structural geometry, and stereochemical constraints via bounded local projections, graph-rigid stereochemical transformations, and periodic symmetry projections, while preserving the geometry already captured by the pretrained model.
